"""Regression: pricing helpers must return integer minor units."""
from app.api import checkout
from app.models import CartLine
from app.pricing import line_total, subtotal
from app.service import quote_cart


def test_line_total_stays_in_minor_units():
    line = CartLine("book", 1234, 1)
    assert line_total(line) == 1234
    assert subtotal([line]) == 1234


def test_quote_and_receipt_preserve_minor_units():
    lines = [CartLine("book", 1234, 1)]
    quote = quote_cart(lines, shipping_minor=250)
    assert quote.subtotal_minor == 1234
    assert quote.total_minor == 1484
    assert checkout(lines, shipping_minor=250) == {
        "subtotal_minor": 1234,
        "shipping_minor": 250,
        "total_minor": 1484,
    }


def test_quantity_scales_minor_units_without_truncation():
    lines = [CartLine("pen", 199, 3)]
    assert subtotal(lines) == 597
    assert quote_cart(lines, shipping_minor=1).total_minor == 598
